description: This file defines a template-based implementation of a Most Recently Used (MRU) cache, including base classes and specializations using std::map and std::unordered_map. It provides methods for inserting, retrieving, peeking, erasing, and managing cache size, with support for iteration and swapping.

classes.name: MRUCacheBase
classes.description: Template base class for MRU cache implementations, managing internal data structures and core cache operations.

classes.name: MRUCache
classes.description: Concrete class for MRU cache storing value types, derived from MRUCacheBase.

classes.name: HashingMRUCache
classes.description: MRU cache implementation using std::unordered_map for key-value storage, derived from MRUCacheBase.

classes.name: MRUCacheStandardMap
classes.description: Template struct defining std::map as the default map type for MRUCacheBase.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a key-value pair in the cache, moving it to the front as most recent.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key and moves it to the front, indicating recent use.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key without affecting its recency order.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Removes an item from the cache by iterator.

methods.name: ShrinkToSize
methods.description: Reduces cache size to a specified number of items.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the cache.
